scope: One local end-to-end explicit run-envelope validation slice; result data only, no execution.

authority.reuse: Imported unchanged; C001 owns snapshot integrity and action consent. No separate approval implementation or approval defaults.
authority.browserAuthorityLimit: Bundled pinned snapshot only, not the current repository ledger or server-side authorization.

contract.numericPolicy: Finite safe-integer JSON numbers, no coercion or negative zero. Text parsing additionally rejects duplicate fields and precision-losing/underflowed numeric literals.
contract.comparisonPolicy: Every explicitly supplied min/max is inclusive and ordered; no missing bound is defaulted.
contract.resultPolicy: executed=false always. Rejections expose neither a validated envelope nor applied limits; valid results contain immutable copies.

tdd.logFormatting: Whitespace-only TAP separator lines were trimmed after the publisher diff --check rejected trailing spaces; assertions, observations, timings and failures are unchanged.

validatorRed.failure: ERR_ASSERTION: false !== true; the module loaded and returned a behaviorally incomplete rejected result.

precisionParserRed.failure: ERR_ASSERTION: raw JSON.parse rounded 1.00000000000000001 into 1 instead of rejecting its source literal.

coverage: Each metric at inclusive minimum/maximum and outside both sides
Explicit changed limits alter comparisons; missing bounds have no defaults
Unknown/missing fields at every record level and invalid record shapes
Unsafe numeric types in metrics, live-run count and bounds
Non-enumerable fields, symbols, accessors without getter execution, inherited fields and prototype keys
Missing/drifted C001 approval and every restricted action
Caller immutability, copied/frozen results and unavailable schema/guard factories

syntax.command: $failed=$false; $lines=foreach($file in Get-ChildItem .\capability\C002 -Recurse -File -Include *.js,*.cjs){$relative=Resolve-Path -Relative $file.FullName; node --check $relative; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){$failed=$true}; "node --check $relative => $LASTEXITCODE"}; $lines | Tee-Object -FilePath .\capability\C002\evidence\syntax.txt; if($failed){exit 1}

actualObservations: Visible C001 pinned contract, all six false operation approval flags and exact JSON Schema; both input textareas initially empty.
Real Enter loads the explicitly labelled synthetic fixture; Tab/Tab/Enter validates and returns focus to the validation button.
Valid result executed=false, liveAzureRuns=0, cloudSpend=0 and productionRuntimeValidated=false.
Editing invalidates stale success; five out-of-range metric paths and exact intervals appear in the visible error table, plus the C001 zero-spend scope error.
Malformed JSON, missing limits, missing max endpoint, unknown SKU field, numeric string, precision-losing literal and duplicate JSON field are explicitly rejected.
Deployment action receives C001 DEPLOYMENT_NOT_APPROVED; non-local mode/live runs and positive cloud budget bounds receive SCOPE_ESCALATION.
Real keyboard Enter on Reset clears both inputs, stale result and error rows, resets aria-invalid, and focuses Envelope JSON.
Zero observed remote requests, normal-page script errors or CSP violations during monitored reload and interactions; the helper initial navigation precedes instrumentation.
The actual C001 guard script request is intentionally blocked on reload; validation and fixture buttons stay disabled with SURFACE_UNAVAILABLE.
Owned isolated session is closed in finally; actual page closure and browser disconnection are asserted.
